verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a Startup Resource Center (articles, checklists, tools) and Venture Capital Services investor introductions. It never mentions a program or partnership with accelerators, incubators, or university ecosystems that gives early startups structured access. These are adjacent founder resources, not the named capability.
